]], 8. 10.

__1 A kind of salt. 
__2 A sort of sugar-cane. (In comp.

__1 scattered clouds.

__1 a measure of oil.

.]]

.]]

.]]

__1 N. of Śiva. 
__2 of Paraśurāma. 
__3 of Rāhu. 
__4 an elephant with a broken tusk. 
-पालः a confectioner. 
-प्रलयः 
__1 a partial destruction of the universe in which all the spheres beneath Svarga are dissolved in one common ruin. 
__2 a quarrel.

-57.]]

.]]

a. [खण्ड्-ण्वुल्] Destroying, tearing, breaking to pieces, removing, &c.

.]]

__1 Candied sugar. 
__2 One who has no nails. 
-Comp. 
-आलु n. sweet potato.

a. [खण्ड्-ल्युट्]

]]; भवज्वरखण्डन 12. 
-नम् 
__1 Breaking or cutting. 
__2 Biting; injuring, hurting; अधरोष्ठखण्डनम् [[

.]] 
__3 Disappointing, frustrating (as in love). 
__4 Interrupting; रसखण्डनवर्जितम् [[

.]] 
__7 Rebellion, opposition. 
__8 Dismissal. 
-Comp. 
-खण्डखाद्यम् N. of a work on logic by Harṣa.

ind.

p. p. [खण्ड्-क्त] 
__1 Cut, broken in pieces. 
__2 Destroyed, annihilated, lost, decayed; खण्डिते च वसुनि [[

.]] 
__3 Refuted (in argument), controverted. 
__4 Rebelled. 
__5 Disappointed, betrayed, abandoned; खण्डितयुवतिविलापम् [[

.]]

.]] 
-ता A woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of infidelity, and who is therefore angry with him; one of the 8 principal Nāyikas in Sanskrit; निद्रावशेन भवताप्यनवेक्षमाणा पर्युत्सुकत्वमबला निशि खण्डितेव [[
.]] She is thus described:--पार्श्वमेति प्रियो यस्या अन्यसंभोगचिह्नितः । सा खण्डितेति कथिता धीरैरीर्ष्याकषायिता ॥ [[S.

.]] 
-Comp.

.]] 
-व्रत a. One who has violated his vow.
